title: Ryouko no Oshaberi Room
native_title: 涼子のおしゃべりルーム
overview:
A fan disc starring Inoue Ryouko from the Roommate series. Drop by Ryouko's room for a chat: she plays host, talks with you and shares something different each day, using the Saturn's internal clock to move from one day to the next.

- Quizzes on the three Roommate games
- A trivia mode in which Ryouko shares facts tied to the day you play
- A photo gallery to browse
